lineage.acr_d09_note: ACR-D0.9 was referenced as attached in Task 33 but was not present in the agent VM, uploads, stores, GitHub, or conversation transcript. Gmail MCP auth was declined. Findings D09-01..14 below are provisional IDs assigned to defects discovered during disposable execution against ACR-D0.6 SQL; remap 1:1 when the authoritative D0.9 text is supplied.

findings.title: ACR-D0.9 source text unavailable in execution environment
findings.evidence: Task 33 claimed attached ACR-D0.9; file absent; Gmail auth declined.
findings.correction: Proceeded with ACR-D0.6 proposed SQL + disposable evidence; remap when D0.9 arrives.

findings.title: RLS policy naming drift vs tp0007 / Appendix F.6
findings.evidence: ACR-D0.6 prose used tenant_isolation_guard; live tp0007 uses tenant_runtime_guard.

findings.title: Mandatory composite FKs used MATCH SIMPLE
findings.evidence: invoice_documents.beneficiary_patient_id is NOT NULL but FK was MATCH SIMPLE (clause 743).
findings.correction: Corrected to MATCH FULL in corrected/01_tp_ops_ledger.sql.

findings.title: RLS/grants specified only in prose, not executable SQL
findings.evidence: Proposed packages lacked ENABLE/FORCE RLS and grants; runtime roles untested.
findings.correction: Added docs/validation/d010/rls_clause746.sql and executed against db_app_runtime.

findings.title: Append-only finance tables lacked revoke/trigger evidence
findings.evidence: payment_receipts UPDATE succeeded under prose-only grants.
findings.correction: Append-only via BEFORE UPDATE/DELETE reject triggers (UPDATE kept for FOR UPDATE locks); case finance_receipt_append_only.

findings.title: Refund cumulative cap not enforced in DDL
findings.evidence: Over-refund inserts possible without app FOR UPDATE discipline.

findings.title: inventory_item_id FK never closed after inventory package
findings.evidence: Ledger left inventory_item_id dangling without deferred FK step.
findings.correction: Corrected inventory package adds MATCH SIMPLE FK when invoice_lines exists.

findings.title: DEPARTMENT scope_kind without departments catalog
findings.evidence: Scopes DDL allowed DEPARTMENT without referent table.
findings.correction: Added departments + integrity trigger in corrected scopes package.

findings.title: Arrival CHECK unsafe for Expand-and-Contract upgrades
findings.evidence: Immediate CHECK on CHECKED_IN∧arrived_at would fail populated upgrades.
findings.correction: Constraint added NOT VALID; VALIDATE after backfill demonstrated.

findings.title: Online closures allowed null service and resource (no target)
findings.evidence: Clinic-wide vs targeted closure ambiguous; empty target accepted.

findings.title: Waitlist/notes missing created_by composite FKs
findings.evidence: Operator attribution columns lacked tenant-scoped FKs.
findings.correction: Added MATCH FULL FKs to user_accounts.

findings.title: Official tp0008+ must not be invented
findings.evidence: Lineage audit: only tp0001–tp0007 on disk; Appendix E.2 ends at TP0007.
findings.correction: Packages remain logical TP-OPS-*; no Alembic files landed.

findings.title: Financial identity CHECK + derived balance reconciliation
findings.evidence: Executable proof of identity CHECK and receipt allocation equality.

findings.title: Practitioner eligibility + FEFO inventory + lifecycle arrival
findings.evidence: Behavioral cases for staff_service_links, FEFO order, CHECKED_IN+arrived_at.
